description: How an AI agent or bot buys one instrument on its own, step by step: the purchase path (wallet only / owner onboarded once / platform account), the three KYC gates, network and verified contract, the issuer route, the measured trading venues, the exit terms where researched (KYC to redeem, minimum, fee, settlement, from issuer documentation), the ordered steps (fund, verify contract, approve exact amount, simulate, deposit or swap, confirm, exit) and the guardrails a wallet policy should enforce. Read-only: it does not build, sign or send a transaction, and it does not say who may buy.

amount_usd.description: Optional amount, used only to word the approval step

title: How an agent buys it
